page.overview:
Who is Dr. Fitzwaggle?

Dr. Fitzwaggle is an eccentric potionmaker from Josgren's Hollow. As an NPC, he is played by Nick Williams.

Dr. Fitzwaggle is a short man of white beard and half-moon glasses, dressed with clothes covered in colorful stains.

He seems slightly distracted all the time, but always very enthusiastic about his products

Dr. Fitzwaggle was one of the potionmakers of Josgren's Hollow, but he wasn't very appreciated, and his products were deemed less than reliable; because of this, the place he got during Potion Con in 839 PD was very bad, and when the whispers attacked he was immediately killed.
